description: List the parliamentary clubs and circles (kluby i koła poselskie: the party groups of MPs in the Sejm) with their ID, full name, number of members and contact details. The ID (e.g. KO, PiS) is what the `club` field of MPs and votes refers to.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; all by default

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-clubs

id.description: Club ID, e.g. KO or PiS

nextOffset.description: Pass as `offset` to get the next page; absent on the last page

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before this page

total.description: Number of matching items on all pages

title: List clubs
